summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, beside show_cursor, with a docstring noting Rich cannot restore titles; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not run: tests and Black were not executed, per instructions. Nothing committed.
